extDesc.message: Turns dark-gray page backgrounds into true black (#000) so OLED pixels switch off.

scopeSiteHint.message: A separate copy of these settings is kept for {0}. Switch back to “All sites” to remove it.

statsReload.message: Reload the page to activate it.

reportSite.message: Report a problem with this site

reportTip.message: Opens a pre-filled GitHub issue with the site name, version and settings. Nothing is sent until you press Submit.

tagAllSitesTip.message: This setting is global; it can't differ per site.

h_presets.message: Soft: only near-black grays. Normal: typical dark-mode sites (recommended). Aggressive: lighter grays too — more black, less contrast between cards.

h_threshold.message: How light a gray may be and still turn black. The swatch shows the lightest shade that turns black. About 28% covers typical dark modes; 40%+ also takes mid-grays.

h_tolerance.message: How colourful a dark shade may be and still count as gray. 0% = pure grays only; about 9% also takes slightly blue or green darks; above 15% strongly coloured darks go black too.

h_borders.message: Also turns thin dark-gray border lines black.

h_pseudo.message: Catches backgrounds drawn by invisible ::before / ::after layers (cards, dividers, sticky headers). Turn off only if something breaks.

h_hideGlow.message: Removes blurred copies of a video or picture drawn behind the content, like YouTube's ambient mode.

h_antiFlash.message: Remembers dark sites and paints them black instantly next time, before the page finishes scanning.

h_perfMode.message: Lighter scanning for heavy pages: no pseudo-layers or borders, smaller batches, ignores inline-style changes. See the ms counter in the popup.

h_expDim.message: Slightly darkens pictures and videos so bright thumbnails don't glare against the black page.

h_expVideo.message: Pushes near-black video pixels to true black so dark scenes switch pixels off. For non-HDR video; costs a little GPU. Turn off if HDR content looks wrong.

h_expText.message: Caps near-white text a little below pure white to reduce glare and halation on black.

h_expEdge.message: Keeps a fine line where a gray panel stood out from what was behind it, so you can still see nested panels.

h_expHover.message: Buttons, links and list rows light up faintly under the pointer.

h_expAlpha.message: Also treats partly see-through dark grays (over 60% opaque) as backgrounds. May hide content behind them.

h_expOverlay.message: Cards that are only a faint white tint (e.g. YouTube's description box) get a weaker tint.

h_expInspector.message: Shows the site's original colours under the pointer and whether they turn black. English only.

h_expDebug.message: Shows exactly which areas are detected.

l_idleCare.message: Dim, then black out idle pages

h_idleCare.message: An untouched page first dims, then fades to black, so static elements don't burn in. Any input wakes it; the first click only wakes. Never while video plays or in background tabs.

h_schedule.message: Outside the chosen hours the extension does nothing (and idle care pauses).

h_lang.message: Language names are shown in their own language. Corrections are welcome on GitHub.

l_updateCheck.message: Check GitHub for new versions (once a day)

h_updateCheck.message: Only the version number is fetched, nothing about you is sent. Installing is still manual: browsers don't let unpacked extensions replace themselves.

lead_general.message: Turns dark-gray page backgrounds into pure black (#000000), so OLED pixels switch fully off. The preview shows what your settings do.

lead_det.message: Which grays count as “dark gray”. Values are percentages of full white (0% = black).

lead_look.message: How the extension treats borders, hidden layers and page loading.

lead_media.message: Optional tweaks for pictures, video and text. All experimental.

lead_exp.message: Extra features that may not suit every site.

lead_care.message: Protects the panel from static images burning in.

lead_sites.message: Where the extension runs and how.

lead_backup.message: Check for new versions and move your settings between browsers.

lead_browser.message: The extension only recolours web pages. The browser frame comes from the optional black theme and the browser's own appearance settings.

shortcutHint.message: Toggle anywhere with Alt+Shift+B (change it on the browser's extension shortcuts page).

scopeEverywhere.message: all sites except the ones I turn off

listOffHint.message: The extension does nothing on these sites (and their subdomains).

listAllowHint.message: Used when “Run on” is set to only the sites I list.

listDeepenHint.message: Only near-blacks turn pure black here; no other changes.

listOwnHint.message: Sites with their own copy of the settings. Create one from the toolbar popup.

backupHint.message: Save all settings (including site lists) to a file, or load them in another browser.

notSettingsFile.message: not an OLED True Black settings file

copied.message: Copied: {0} — paste it into the address bar.

limits.message: Does not work on browser-internal pages, the built-in PDF viewer, extension stores or the sidebar. For local files, enable “Allow access to file URLs” in the extension details.

pvNote.message: A mock page — real sites differ. Hover a panel to see its colour.
